self_assessment.weakest_area: Badge `solid` variant carries more visual weight than the original `subtle`. The trade was made to clear the 4.5:1 contrast bar; design-guidelines.md authorises rose for 'badges for featured content' so this fits the 90/10 budget rule. Worth a glance to confirm the hero feels balanced with three rose accents (tier + maturity + copy button focus).
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Resolving the .skill-prose pre tabindex via parseSkillMd post-process rather than client-side mutation. Server-side keeps SSR/keyboard parity and avoids a hydration-time DOM walk; cost is bumping the rendered cache key from v5 to v6 to evict stale entries.

known_limitations: Compatibility badges are static signals of Agent Skills open-standard support, not data-driven
Curators without a rationale appear only in the avatar count, not as named list entries
Pre-existing HTML validation issue: SKILL.md markdown `#` headings render as <h1> inside the prose article (not introduced by this change)
Pre-existing HTML validation issue: tables in SKILL.md render `<th>` without scope attribute
next_steps: Re-run /nuxt-frontend-review skills-slug-relayout-0429-1025 to confirm the 3 review issues are cleared
Consider follow-up: a curators slide-over reachable from the avatar stack +N overflow, to restore name visibility for curators-without-rationale

fixes.issue: [HARD REJECT] responsive-overflow: hero grid overflows at 375px
fixes.change: Added `grid-cols-1` to hero grid and `min-w-0` to both column children so the truncated install command no longer drives the implicit grid track to max-content.
fixes.verified: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360/375/414/768/1024/1280 on /skills/anthropics/skill-creator across all 3 test routes (was 518/438/446 before)

fixes.issue: [RUBRIC] accessibility-contrast: tier and maturity badges below 4.5:1 in dark mode
fixes.change: Tier badges (official/maintainer) and `active` maturity badge switched from variant=`subtle` to variant=`solid` so foreground is white (oklch(1 0 0)) on full-chroma rose (oklch(0.555 0.225 17.32)) instead of rose-on-tinted-rose. Steady/stale maturity badges stay `subtle` neutral.
fixes.verified: Light + dark mode rendered: text color=oklch(1 0 0), background=oklch(0.555 0.225 17.32) on both tier badge and active maturity badge.

fixes.issue: [RUBRIC] accessibility-keyboard: SKILL.md `<pre>` blocks scrollable but not focusable
fixes.change: Post-process the rendered SKILL.md HTML in `parseSkillMd` to inject `tabindex="0"` on every `<pre>` element (regex skips elements that already declare tabindex). Bumped rendered cache key v5 -> v6 to evict stale entries. Added `:focus-visible` outline using `--ui-primary` so the focused pre block has a visible ring.
fixes.verified: All 15 `.skill-prose pre` blocks on /skills/anthropics/skill-creator render with `tabindex="0"`.
